messages:
serena-partner: Kicking off StratoGrid marketplace + HW + SI launch thread. Need owners for assets, demo, legal, and launch ops. Target publish Mon 08:00 PT.

jose-prod: I'll own the marketplace manifest and SKU mapping. Need StratoGrid peak throughput numbers and approved SKU names.

kai-sis: SI checklist: connector auth done, wiring to aggregator pending final telemetry keys from StratoGrid. I'll need `model_tag` added to telemetry.

li-marketing: Draft blog + landing ready. Need partner quote and logo vector. Proposed CTAs: "Try StratoGrid on Redwood Marketplace" and "Request on-prem trial". Also request tracking UTMs.

rachel-legal: Please send draft PR text. Two items: confirm logo license and avoid claims about "zero cost" or guaranteed savings.

ton y-ops: Ops: plan autoscale pre-warm for first 24h and set rate limiting on marketplace ingress. We'll run preflight Wed 15:30 PT.

serena-partner: Sent signed asset pack to Rachel. Partner approved quote (short): "StratoGrid + Redwood deliver stable LLM performance on accelerator appliances."

rachel-legal: Good. Minor wording edit: replace "stable" with "predictable". Also ok on logo.

li-marketing: Updated one-liner for tile: "On-prem accelerators + Redwood runtime — predictable latency for LLMs." Under 140 chars. UTMs: `?utm_source=marketplace&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=stratogrid_launch`.

jose-prod: Manifest note: will include `max_streams` and `token_limit` per SKU. Kai, can you recommend safe defaults?

kai-sis: Recommend small: 1 stream/4k, medium: 3 streams/16k, large: 6 streams/64k. We'll watch in the first 48h.

release-bot: CI: marketplace branch passed schema checks at 2681000100. :white_check_mark:

li-marketing: Dry-run request: Thu 16:00 PT — simulate press traffic and social push. Ops and SI please join.

ton y-ops: On Thu 16:00. I'll create #live-stratogrid channel for the run and prod.

serena-partner: Final checklist owners: quote (serena), legal signoff (rachel), assets (li), manifest (jose), SI runbook (kai), ops channel + preflight (tony). If any blocker, flag by Tue EOD.

kai-sis: Will post SI runbook Tue noon.

rachel-legal: Reviewing PR tonight. Will add inline edits.

li-marketing: Locking CMS publish window after legal signoff. Thanks team.

jose-prod: LGTM

serena-partner: Thanks — keeping this thread as canonical signoff.
